nom: COSRX The 6 Peptide Skin Booster Serum with Niacinamide & Hyaluronic Acid

segments.sensitive: Most reviewers with sensitive skin, including some who are acne-prone or easily sensitized, report no irritation and even a soothing effect, but a minority describe burning, redness, itching, or a rash, including one severe reaction requiring antihistamines and ice and one reviewer with rosacea whose skin turned red, inflamed, and painful.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin mostly report the serum leaves their face hydrated, smoother, and less dull, often layering a moisturizer on top to seal it in, though one reviewer with dry skin found it did little for her face and used it on her body instead.
segments.oily: Most reviewers with oily skin say the serum feels lightweight and does not add oiliness, several saying it left their skin hydrated rather than greasy, though one reviewer with oily skin says it broke her out and left her face oily and drenched, and another notices some overnight greasiness that rinses off easily.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin consistently describe the serum as lightweight enough to layer well, reporting hydration and plumpness without added oiliness, plus improvement in fine lines for several.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their late 30s through late 50s consistently report visibly softer lines, firmer or more youthful-looking skin, and a brighter glow, several saying the effect was noticeable within days.

concerns.aging: Many reviewers report visibly softer fine lines and firmer, plumper skin within days to weeks of regular use, particularly around the forehead and mouth, though one reviewer notes she was trying several new products at once and can't be fully certain this one alone caused the improvement.
concerns.dehydration: The large majority of reviewers, across oily, dry, and combination skin, say the serum measurably increases hydration and plumpness, often within days; one reviewer with dry skin, however, found it did not moisturize her face enough and got better results using it on her body instead.
concerns.redness: A few reviewers report the serum triggered new redness, burning, or a rash, including one with rosacea who says it caused a painful flare; separately, one reviewer with ongoing redness in her cheeks says it has cleared somewhat in her forehead and chin, though not fully.
concerns.barrier: The one reviewer who mentions a barrier-related condition, dyshidrotic eczema, calls the serum a must-have during flare-ups, patting in several pumps and sealing with an occlusive moisturizer.
concerns.spots: Several reviewers report visible fading of dark spots, hyperpigmentation, or post-acne scarring within one to a few weeks of regular use, including one who calls it the only product that has helped with longstanding neck hyperpigmentation and acne scarring.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers with acne-prone skin report clearer skin, fewer breakouts, or improved adult acne within weeks of regular use, but two reviewers report the opposite: the serum broke them out, and one says it irritates and breaks her out every time she tries it.
concerns.oiliness: Most reviewers who mention oil control say the serum is light enough not to add oiliness and, for several, actively helped balance excess oil, but one reviewer reports it left her face oily and drenched after it broke her out, and another notices some overnight greasiness that rinses off easily.

aspects.libelle: Pump or nozzle makes dispensing messy
Outperforms pricier serums for the cost
A little goes a long way
May not pair well with benzoyl peroxide

extraits.texte: I have never left a review before now. I tried this as a "free birthday gift" from ulta. At first, i thought my skin felt super soft and thought i may have found a new product. Then within 5 min..the redness began. Then burning, then severe itching. I immediately went to wash my face thoroughly. 3 bendadryls later and ice packs the swelling, redness, burning and itching began to subside. I am not quite sure what I'm allergic to in this. But people with sensitive skin should be very cautious about using this.

I have dry skin and this didn't seem to do much of anything for my face. I did find another use for it though. I use it in my body out of the shower, let is absorb for a few minutes and then apply body lotion. It seems to work better for my body.

extraits.titre: Broke me out and made me oily :(
extraits.texte: I was really disappointed with this product :( it completely broke me out and had my face so oily it felt drenched.

I got a sample size when u bought a perfume a while back. The back of my neck had gotten so dark from hyperpigmentation. I also gave scaring from zits on my face. This is the only product that has helped. Ive only been using it for a week and I already see the difference!

As someone who has combo skin, I really enjoy layering lightweight products instead of using thick creams and serums. This serum I immediately noticed hydration and plump to the skin the next day. My fine lines near my mouth and in forehead less noticable. Its so light and my skin drinks it up. Paired with my gel moisturizer I feel like its the perfect skincare combination for my combo skin type as we enter summer.

This product is LITERALLY like a genie in a bottle. I was using pure hylauronic acid for my skin care and it was alright and did its job. When I switched to this product, oh my goodness it changed my skin so much. My texture and pores were so minimal it was crazy and my skin was SOO bouncy. I have dry/very oily skin so I tend to lean towards more simple, hydrating products. This was it!! I also live in a very hot, dry area and this did not make me more oily than I already am. Put your pennies in a jar and buy this!!

Wow! This product is amazing. I have sensitive skin and had zero reaction to this product. In fact, this feels so very soothing on the skin. It is a wonderful texture, perhaps like a slippery thick water. It is not at all sticky ans absorbs well. I used it twice a day and it worked well under moisturizers and makeup. Using this i noticed fine lines decreased, texture very noticeably smoothed out, skin stayed plump and firm. Oil and dryness seems balanced. Will repurchase this one!
